description: An old, bald, white-bearded man in a patched grey-brown hooded robe holds a wooden staff and sets his hands on a silver and gold tiara resting on a rough wooden table. Behind him, several men in red hooded robes and red cloaks stand in a dim stone room with a window at left and a doorway at right. A draped red cloth with gold trim and a white cloth with a black cross lie on the table at lower left. The painting is oil-like, dark and candlelit, and has no visible text or border.
